title.zh: 豁免在美军服役的菲律宾陆军军官与士兵就其因此类服役取得的薪金、保险与供养津贴缴纳1942年至1945年各纳税年度所得税，并规定退还此前就此项收入已征税款的法案
title.en: An Act Exempting Officers and Enlisted Men of the Army of the Philippines Who Served in the Armed Forces of the United States from the Payment of Income Tax on Their Compensation, Insurance, and Maintenance and Support Allowances Earned by Virtue of Such Service Corresponding to the Taxable Years Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Two to Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Five, Inclusive, and Providing for the Refund of Taxes Heretofore Collected on Income so Earned
title.orig: An Act Exempting Officers and Enlisted Men of the Army of the Philippines Who Served in the Armed Forces of the United States from the Payment of Income Tax on Their Compensation, Insurance, and Maintenance and Support Allowances Earned by Virtue of Such Service Corresponding to the Taxable Years Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Two to Nineteen Hundred and Forty-Five, Inclusive, and Providing for the Refund of Taxes Heretofore Collected on Income so Earned

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1948/ra_210_1948.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The provisions of existing law to the contrary notwithstanding, officers and enlisted men of the Army of the Philippines who served in the Armed Forces of the United States, including their beneficiaries, are hereby exempted from the payment of income tax on their compensation, insurance and maintenance and support allowances earned by virtue of such service for the taxable years Nineteen Hundred and Forty-two, Nineteen Hundred and Forty-three, Nineteen Hundred and Forty-four and Nineteen Hundred and Forty-five. Income so earned shall be exempt from income tax regardless of the date of receipt thereof. The filing of returns thereof shall not be required.

Any amount heretofore collected as income tax on income exempted under the provisions of this Act shall be refunded upon proper application to the Collector of Internal Revenue by the individual claiming exemption.

This Act shall be applicable to officers and enlisted men of the Army of the Philippines who were inducted into the United States Armed Forces in the Far East, as well as to guerrillas duly recognized, whether collectively or individually, including their beneficiaries.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 1, 1948.
